newsitem.title: INDIA: India party makes one km long national flag.
newsitem.headline: India party makes one km long national flag.

text.p: A regional Indian party rolled out a national flag more than one km (0.6 mile) long to mark the 50th anniversary of independence from British rule on Friday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

"No nation has so far prepared a flag more than one km long," the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK), which rules the southern state of Tamil Nadu, was quoted as saying in a statement after unveiling the 1,050 metre (yard) flag at Madras.
PTI said Tamil Nadu chief minister Muthuvel Karunanidhi set off a procession featuring the saffron, white and green coloured flag.
Marchers carried the flag along a four km (2.5 mile) route, PTI said. It did not state the width of the flag.
The DMK is a member of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's ruling United Front coalition.
